theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have key : ∀ A, A ∉ P ↔ Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have himg : Finset.univ \ P = P.image compl := by
    ext A
    simp [key]
  have hsum := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ P)
  rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ compl_injective, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set,
    show Fintype.card S = Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 from (Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos).symm,
    pow_succ] at hsum
  omega
